command_or_procedure.command: uv run python scripts/fault_drill.py --scenario redis --run --environment local --confirm local-fault-drill --timeout-seconds 60 --report-path evidence/m5/20260719-redis-outage-recovery.json
uv run python scripts/fault_drill.py --scenario minio --run --environment local --confirm local-fault-drill --timeout-seconds 60 --report-path evidence/m5/20260719-minio-outage-recovery.json
docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml --profile observability up -d --wait prometheus grafana; query Prometheus readiness/targets and Grafana dashboard search

limitations: Evaluation uses a deterministic gateway and controlled eight-dimensional vectors.
Load evidence consists of a bounded health baseline and a dependency-inclusive ready run with host/API resource sampling; neither is a production capacity claim.
Fault drills and observability runtime checks are local Compose evidence; they do not prove managed failover, production RTO, or production telemetry availability.
Implementation and evidence are uncommitted working-tree artifacts, not immutable review evidence.

manual_gates.required_evidence: real provider/model quality, representative corpus, cost, citations, refusal and tail latency
isolated production-like environment, immutable images, repeated workload, resource and queue telemetry
managed scrape, retention, alert routing, dashboard and incident ownership
